label: 📊 Logistic regression
description: Binary classification via logistic regression. Fits a model to predict a 0/1 (or true/false) target from numeric features, adds predicted_class + predicted_proba columns, and emits per-feature coefficients + intercept + accuracy as a side-effect artifact.

targetColumn.label: Target column (binary)
targetColumn.help: The 0/1 (or true/false) outcome column to predict.

featureColumns.label: Feature columns
featureColumns.help: Numeric columns to use as predictors. Encode categoricals via the one-hot or cast_type steps first.

regularization.label: Regularization
regularization.help: l2: ridge (default, shrinks coefficients). l1: lasso (drops weak features to zero). none: pure unregularised fit; can overfit on small / collinear data.

c.label: Regularization strength (C)
c.help: Inverse of regularization weight — smaller C = stronger regularization. Ignored when regularization = none.
